description: Trade-show and exhibition editions starting in a date window, soonest first, optionally filtered by country, vertical or venue. Each row has event, dates, city, country, venue, organizer, source_url and as_of. Use this for 'what shows are on in …' questions; pass `cursor` from the previous answer for the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

from.description: Start of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

to.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 24 months after today. Defaults to from + 12 months.

venue.description: Venue slug or uuid from search_venues.

name: upcoming_events
title: Upcoming trade shows
